# TransformFit Higgsfield Image Prompts

**Date:** 2026-07-07
**Generated by:** RIG Image Atelier (Dario Chen)
**Product:** TransformFit Fitness App
**Format:** PNG, 2K resolution (2560×1440 for 16:9, 2048×2048 for 1:1, 1440×2560 for 9:16)
**Source:** `TransformFit Fitness App Design AI Employee Prompt.md`

---

## Visual Direction Summary

TransformFit visual identity:
- **Primary:** Dark canvas (#0D0D0F) with warm orange accent (#FF6B35)
- **Secondary:** Deep purple (#7B2D8E), recovery blue (#3B82F6)
- **Mood:** Cinematic, premium, athletic, calm, intelligent
- **Photography:** Real, grounded, aspirational — NOT stock-like or shame-based
- **Data viz:** Clear enough to act on in 3 seconds
- **Hard blocks:** No body-shaming, no fake transformations, no generic AI-fitness visuals, no dark patterns

## Asset 1: Landing Hero

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Filename** | `landing_hero.png` |
| **Dimensions** | 16:9 (2560×1440) |
| **Format** | PNG, 2K |
| **Mood** | Cinematic, dramatic, aspirational |
| **Color palette** | Dark canvas (#0D0D0F), orange accent (#FF6B35), purple undertone (#7B2D8E), warm highlights |
| **App location** | Landing screen — full-screen background |
| **Accessibility** | Ensure sufficient contrast for overlaid white text; avoid busy center where CTAs will sit |

### Prompt

```
A cinematic wide-angle photograph of an athletic person mid-movement in a dark industrial gym. 
The subject is captured in a powerful athletic stance — not posing, but actively training with 
focus and intention. Dramatic side lighting from the left in warm orange (#FF6B35) and from the 
right in deep purple (#7B2D8E) creates strong chiaroscuro. The gym environment is dark, moody, 
and atmospheric with visible chalk dust particles suspended in the volumetric light beams. 
The floor is polished dark concrete with subtle reflections. The subject wears dark athletic 
wear — grounded and real, not hyper-stylized. The composition leaves the right third relatively 
dark and clean for text overlay. Shot on a cinema camera with shallow depth of field, 
film grain, 2.39:1 cinematic crop feel. The mood is aspirational without being intimidating — 
this person is focused, not showing off. Premium fitness editorial photography quality.
```

### Negative Prompt

```
stock photo, generic gym, bright fluorescent lighting, body-shaming imagery, before/after 
transformation, shirtless flexing pose, mirror selfie, motivational text overlay, neon colors, 
cartoon, illustration, AI-generated look, plastic skin, oversaturated, busy background, 
cluttered equipment, bright colors, white background, low quality, blurry, watermark
```

## Asset 2: Home Background

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Filename** | `home_background.png` |
| **Dimensions** | 16:9 (2560×1440) |
| **Format** | PNG, 2K |
| **Mood** | Calm, intelligent, premium |
| **Color palette** | Deep dark (#0D0D0F), orange node accents (#FF6B35), purple connections (#7B2D8E), subtle warm glow |
| **App location** | Home screen — behind recovery circle and today cards |
| **Accessibility** | Very subtle — must not compete with foreground UI elements. Low opacity recommended |

### Prompt

```
An abstract data visualization rendered as a neural network on a deep black canvas (#0D0D0F). 
Scattered nodes of warm orange (#FF6B35) and deep purple (#7B2D8E) are connected by thin, 
elegant luminous lines that form an organic web pattern. The nodes pulse with subtle glow — 
some brighter, some dimmer — suggesting living data processing. The overall density is sparse 
and breathable, with the center slightly more open for UI overlay. Fine particle effects float 
gently between the connections, suggesting ambient intelligence. The aesthetic is premium tech — 
think Bloomberg Terminal meets Apple Health, not sci-fi hologram. Rendered in a clean, modern 
3D style with depth of field blur on the outer edges. The mood is calm confidence — intelligence 
working quietly in the background. No text, no charts, no recognizable UI elements.
```

### Negative Prompt


### Prompt

## Production Notes

### File Naming Convention
```
transformfit_{asset_name}_{dimensions}_{version}.png
Example: transformfit_landing_hero_16x9_v1.png
```

### Export Specifications
- **Format:** PNG-24 (no alpha unless compositing required)
- **Resolution:** 2K minimum (2560×1440 for 16:9, 2048×2048 for 1:1, 1440×2560 for 9:16)
- **Color space:** sRGB for screen delivery
- **Compression:** Lossless or minimal lossy (quality 95+)

### Flutter Asset Integration
```yaml
# pubspec.yaml assets section
assets:
  - assets/images/landing_hero.png
  - assets/images/home_background.png
  - assets/images/wellness_background.png
  - assets/images/nutrition_background.png
  - assets/images/coach_avatar.png
  - assets/images/pr_celebration.png
  - assets/images/sleep_recovery_background.png
  - assets/images/app_store_hero.png
```

### Overlay Guidance
| Asset | Overlay Content | Text Color | Safe Zone |
|---|---|---|---|
| Landing Hero | App name, tagline, CTA button | White (#FFFFFF) | Right third, bottom third |
| Home Background | Recovery circle, today cards | White/Orange | Center, low opacity bg |
| Wellness Background | Readiness score, metrics | White/Blue | Center, very low opacity bg |
| Nutrition Background | Macro cards, meal log | White/Gold | Center, dark edges |
| Coach Avatar | None (standalone icon) | N/A | Center with padding |
| PR Celebration | PR number, exercise name | White/Gold | Center overlay |
| Sleep/Recovery | Sleep metrics, HRV | White/Blue | Center, low opacity bg |
| App Store Hero | Feature captions | White/Orange | Top and bottom padding |

### Quality Checklist
- [ ] No body-shaming imagery
- [ ] No fake transformation photos
- [ ] No medical/injury visual claims
- [ ] No specific brand logos or text in generated images
- [ ] Sufficient contrast for overlaid text (WCAG AA minimum)
- [ ] Images work at 50% opacity as backgrounds
- [ ] Coach avatar recognizable at 48px
- [ ] PR celebration legible at overlay size
- [ ] App Store hero legible at thumbnail size
- [ ] All images feel like one cohesive visual system
